productName: French Country Full Guard Rail Kit
description:
French Country Full Guard Rail Kit is the full-length guard rail option for the French Country cribs (Slat Style Front and Panel Style Front), for use once the crib is converted to a bed. It is not a standalone bed.

Made of solid hardwood and finished to match your crib, it runs the entire length of the bed.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
